name: 宮本武蔵_手ぶら_待機_4コマ_v2.png
prompt: Create exactly one horizontal 4-frame game sprite strip of the specific Miyamoto Musashi shown on the attached setting sheet, using its side-view design, not the front or back views. Canvas 1024x256 pixels, four equal 256x256 square cells with no gutters, borders, or overlap. One full-body character per cell, strict right-facing profile. Preserve the same lean adult swordsman rough tied-back black hair, white headband and trailing tails, stubble and intense eyes, worn gray-brown kimono with the right sleeve off, light leg wraps and dark straw sandals. No armor. UNARMED: remove both swords completely, no weapons at the waist, and both hands are empty closed fists held in a steady long-weapon grip pose, right fist forward and left fist behind. Idle breathing loop: frame 1 low ready guard; frame 2 chest rises slightly and headband tails sway back; frame 3 chest eases down and loose kimono hem shifts subtly; frame 4 settles toward the starting pose. All four poses differ subtly, while face, clothing, scale, feet and fist positions stay consistent. Feet on y=230, full standing height about 205 pixels, centered in each cell, at least 16 pixels clearance from top/left/right edges. Crisp dark outline and painted anime-realistic arcade beat-em-up rendering. Background exactly flat pure RGB #FF00FF throughout, no floor, shadow, gradient, vignette, text, labels, extra people, scenery, objects, weapons, or borders.
visualReview: 設定画の右向き武蔵を目視照合。両刀と腰武器は完全になく、空の両拳は持ち替え用の前後グリップ位置を維持。4コマに呼吸・布・鉢巻の差分、頭身・接地・衣装と側面向きを確認。
gif: 4 frames, 80ms each; decoded contact sheet visually reviewed
